title: Yelp’s Best New Restaurants of 2026
summary: Discover Yelp's 25 Best New Restaurants of 2026: 1. Filthy Animal, Tempe, Arizona; 2. Firstborn, Los Angeles, California; 3. Limusina, New York, New York; and many more.
body_markdown:
#### Discover 25 top-rated new restaurants shaping America’s dining scene with innovative chefs, bold menus, and beautifully designed spaces


Key takeaways


-


Yelp’s Best New Restaurants of 2026 highlights top U.S. dining destinations, chef-driven menus, and exciting culinary experiences, as ranked by Yelp data and community reviews


-


This year’s hottest trends: celebrity steakhouses, destination brunch spots, and Indian cuisine’s big moment


-


Newcomers in places like Creve Coeur, Missouri, and Winter Park, Florida, land top Yelp rankings alongside restaurants in New York, Los Angeles, and Las Vegas


From jungle-themed live-fire cooking in Tempe to Michelin-starred coastal tasting menus in Carlsbad,


Yelp’s Best New Restaurants of 2026 spotlights the exceptional U.S. dining destinations that Yelpers can’t stop recommending.


On this year’s list, you’ll find everything from Los Angeles’[Firstborn](https://www.yelp.com/biz/firstborn-los-angeles-2) (#2), where Chinese-American flavors meet French techniques, to Kansas City’s star-powered[1587 Prime](https://www.yelp.com/biz/1587-prime-kansas-city-2) (#6), the hard-to-book steakhouse from Patrick Mahomes, Travis Kelce, and Noble 33. Big-city debuts shine alongside smaller-market hits, including[Oh London](https://www.yelp.com/biz/oh-london-creve-coeur) (#13) in Creve Coeur, Missouri, where British pub comfort food, Sunday jazz brunch, and themed events have turned a roomy suburban restaurant into a community gathering place.


Chosen with the help of Yelp’s passionate community of reviewers, these newcomers aren’t just serving memorable food — they’re creating unforgettable experiences.


#### What’s new in 2026 dining trends?


The 2026 steakhouse: Big, big energy.


Yelp searches for “[steak near me](https://www.yelp.com/search?find_desc=steak+near+me) ” have increased 59% over the last year alone and hit an all-time high in August 2026.*[1587 Prime](https://www.yelp.com/biz/1587-prime-kansas-city-2) (#6), for one, is channeling high-energy Kansas City sports fandom into a luxe steakhouse with prime beef, Japanese A5 Wagyu, live music, and a martini cart. Reno’s[Toro Bravo](https://www.yelp.com/biz/toro-bravo-reno-2) (#11) delivers high-voltage vibes pairing steakhouse cuts with Latin-inspired sides, handmade tortillas, and elevated dishes like Ancho Chile–Rubbed New York Steak with bone marrow butter.


Yelp called it: Indian cuisine in the spotlight.


[Yelp’s 2026 Trend Forecast](https://www.yelp.com/article/2026-food-and-drink-trends) predicted high demand for new-wave Indian cuisine, with searches for “[Indian bowls](https://www.yelp.com/search?find_desc=indian+bowls) ” up 135% and “[Indian food buffet near me](https://www.yelp.com/search?find_desc=indian+food+buffet) ” rising a whopping 459% (comparing Sept. 2024–Aug. 2025 to the previous 12-month period).** At New York’s[Ambassadors Clubhouse](https://www.yelp.com/biz/ambassadors-clubhouse-new-york) (#10), the Sethi siblings bring the opulence of Punjabi royal kitchens and energy of North Indian street food to NoMad (Yelpers have been eagerly awaiting it, too, with searches for the restaurant up 8,214%).** In Menlo Park,[Eylan](https://www.yelp.com/biz/eylan-menlo-park) (#4) infuses Cal-Indian cooking with seasonal produce, wood-fired proteins, and clever takes on traditional breads.


Brunch: This year’s top dining destination.


[Yelp’s Top Foodie Cities](https://www.yelp.com/article/yelp-and-lyft-name-the-top-foodie-cities-of-2026) reveals that “breakfast and brunch” is the most searched restaurant cuisine in every big food-loving city — and several of these new spots are meeting that demand. Las Vegas’[Bar Boheme](https://www.yelp.com/biz/bar-boheme-las-vegas-2) (#7), for instance, serves a wildly popular French brasserie brunch, while Washington, D.C.’s[Lobby Bar](https://www.yelp.com/biz/lobby-bar-washington) (#17) brings playful, cocktail-forward energy to weekend brunching near Capitol Hill.


#### Hungry? Get ready to save these spots to your must-visit list.


On the[Yelp mobile app](https://www.yelp.com/mobile) , save them to the “Want to Try” list in[your Collections](https://www.yelp.com/article/yelp-collections-save-organize-and-share-your-lists-of-favorite-places-and-pros) . (Or search our[Best New Restaurants Collection](https://www.yelp.com/collection/d0MC6LlGRHFphmO4hDThzw/Best-New-Restaurants-2026) .) And don’t forget to use[Yelp Assistant](https://www.yelp.com/article/yelp-assistant-your-new-favorite-way-to-find-it-book-it-and-fix-it) , our AI-powered chatbot, to plan your next restaurant visit.


Need the Yelp mobile app?


[Download it here](https://www.yelp.com/mobile) .


Have you discovered a new restaurant that didn’t make our list? Let us know on Instagram and TikTok with #Yelp. We only know how good these new spots are if you take the time to review them or share pictures on Yelp!


How we did it:


This is a list of the best new restaurants in the U.S. in 2026, according to Yelp. We identified full-service businesses in the restaurant category, which opened after January 1, 2025, then ranked those spots using a number of factors, including the total volume and ratings of reviews, between January 1, 2025, and June 11, 2026. When available, all businesses on the list have a passing health score as of June 1, 2026. Finally, we consulted with Yelp Trend Expert Tara Lewis to zero in on what spots Yelpers were loving.


## 1.[Filthy Animal](http://www.yelp.com/biz/filthy-animal-tempe) , Tempe, Arizona


From left: Culinary Director Chef Ivan Gonzalez; photo courtesy of Filthy Animal. Pibil Dumplings; photo via


[Travis T.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/filthy-animal-tempe?select=K8Zot2JvXjEp5blC0KyOEg) on Yelp. Interior; photo via


[Scarlett M.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/filthy-animal-tempe?select=Ge8YhWO0fp8Ci1czFVMqMA) on Yelp.


This jungle-themed hotspot proves that a restaurant named after a line from


Home Alone


can be a thrilling culinary experience. The latest innovation from restaurateur Teddy Myers’ Pretty Decent Concepts (also behind Phoenix favorites[Wren & Wolf](https://www.yelp.com/biz/wren-and-wolf-phoenix) ,[Carry On](https://www.yelp.com/biz/carry-on-phoenix) , and[Cleaverman](https://www.yelp.com/biz/cleaverman-phoenix) ), Filthy Animal has transformed a former Mill Avenue P.F. Chang’s space into a serious dining destination. Executive Chef Rene Vargas commands an open fire pit, turning out creative American dishes with smoky depth and global flair. The immersive safari-themed decor — with leopard prints, dramatic lighting, lush greenery, and stuffed exotic animals — creates a “[sexy, dark and moody](https://www.yelp.com/biz/filthy-animal-tempe?hrid=_lEMW91tivV0zgXpYOEXrQ&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ”


ambiance. “There are Asian, Mexican, and tropical influences, but it’s all focused around the wood fire pit,” Myers tells Yelp. “It’s a primal style of cooking.”


Must-try starters include “[pillowy soft](https://www.yelp.com/biz/filthy-animal-tempe?hrid=7cEurdEwFB6JWMzX7fKadw&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” Milk Bread with miso tomato butter; Tuna Pineapple Ceviche with plantain chips; and beef tartare studded with grill-smoked ingredients. For entrees, Yelpers recommend the “[genius](https://www.yelp.com/biz/filthy-animal-tempe?hrid=5xP0usvFDu1wE6XAAxx6Jg&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” Lemongrass Half Chicken with jalapeno jam and the Lobster Mac and Cheese with thick noodles — “[something I’ll forever dream about](https://www.yelp.com/biz/filthy-animal-tempe?hrid=_lEMW91tivV0zgXpYOEXrQ&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) .” Don’t miss “[divine](https://www.yelp.com/biz/filthy-animal-tempe?hrid=z4Had3LVOQ9A1Sg67ci2Rg&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” roasted oysters topped with gochujang butter and Chihuahua queso.


Insider tip:


For pre-dinner cocktails, stop by[Drop Dead Gorgeous](https://www.yelp.com/biz/drop-dead-gorgeous-tempe) , a ’70s-inspired speakeasy hidden inside the restaurant.


Fast fact:


Myers’ new wood-fired Italian restaurant with James Beard Award-winning chef Scott Conant,[Roman God of Fire](https://www.yelp.com/biz/roman-god-of-fire-tempe-3) , opened in downtown Tempe in August.


Yelpers say:


“Phenomenal dining experience! We tried multiple appetizers, and the grilled oysters were the best-tasting we have ever had (so good that we had to order another round). For my main course I opted for the ribeye, and it was nicely seasoned and cooked a perfect medium rare. The milk bread was shockingly \[good\]… this was the first time I’ve ever had tomato butter, but definitely won’t be my last.” —[Andrew C.](https://www.yelp.com/biz/filthy-animal-tempe?hrid=301mmvY90m99nBowWC1jjw&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) (35 cocktail bar reviews)


## 2.[Firstborn](http://www.yelp.com/biz/firstborn-los-angeles-2) , Los Angeles, California


From left: Interior; photo via


[Brian Y.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/firstborn-los-angeles-2?select=jtortWe5F35t2qe6imWNzw) on Yelp. Chef-owner Anthony Wang; photo courtesy of Firstborn by Ron De Angelis. Mussels Escabeche with jalapeno; photo via


[Anthony C.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/firstborn-los-angeles-2?select=ePJ_5Kaz-aVboVCKr9wk1g) on Yelp.


An art-deco gem in L.A.’s historic Chinatown


, this Michelin-recognized newcomer


delivers a “[remarkably complex](https://www.yelp.com/biz/firstborn-los-angeles-2?hrid=DbER6UJTCEiBuHF4ZC2bTQ&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” dining experience. Chef-owner Anthony Wang blends his Chinese-American heritage with classic European training to create a highly seasonal, evolving tasting menu that takes diners on a “[journey through flavors, textures, and fresh ingredients.](https://www.yelp.com/biz/firstborn-los-angeles-2?hrid=RNQWrjj3I9ry5IQangkORg&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” At just $68, the high-value prix-fixe meal — with three choices per course, plus optional additions — might include such standouts as caviar blinis, duck sausage, or an exceptionally crispy Chongqing Fried Chicken dressed in house-made chili crisp and roasted chicken jus. Sides like savory duck fat rice are absolute must-tries, as is an “[out-of-this-world](https://www.yelp.com/biz/firstborn-los-angeles-2?hrid=z5gnF2HCscX0tb60OTi7nA&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” melon shaved-ice dessert. (Some items are also available for delivery.)


“Many of the ideas are rooted in nostalgia from my upbringing,” Chef Anthony tells Yelp. “Much of the menu is driven by seasonal availability,” he adds, so dishes change with farmers market produce offerings. Whether you’re sipping cocktails that look like “[something out of a sci-fi movie](https://www.yelp.com/biz/firstborn-los-angeles-2?hrid=tdxlbnQArD8aPmWcBAFmqA&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” or enjoying a date under “[romantic lighting](https://www.yelp.com/biz/firstborn-los-angeles-2?hrid=92UEdmS3yR1OFEdqv7JYVw&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ,” Firstborn honors its neighborhood’s legacy while pushing culinary boundaries.


Yelpers say:


“The food was absolutely amazing from start to finish. The highlights were the celery root blini with crème fraîche and Ossetra caviar, trout tartare, duck sausage, and grilled short ribs. And a special shoutout to the fried boneless chicken leg — it was delicious! My partner ordered the non-alcoholic Hojicha Orange Milk Punch, which was phenomenal.” —[Alex H.](https://www.yelp.com/biz/firstborn-los-angeles-2?hrid=IIIuM2n228YzJkA5MDBkLg&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct))


## 3.[Limusina](http://www.yelp.com/biz/limusina-new-york) , New York, New York


From left: Executive Chef Craig Koketsu; photo courtesy of Limusina. Interior; photo via


[Anthony C.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/limusina-new-york?select=UA2bfCuWq7bg-NahBpAk4A) on Yelp. Filet mignon; photo via


[Anthony C.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/limusina-new-york?start=120&select=lc5PB2NYOSIuokNdtVzyBA) on Yelp.


This stunning Hudson Yards hotspot


from the Quality Branded restaurant group (Michelin-starred[Don Angie](https://www.yelp.com/biz/don-angie-new-york) and[Bad Roman](https://www.yelp.com/biz/bad-roman-new-york) ) takes Mexican cuisine to dramatic heights. The “[sexy, chic](https://www.yelp.com/biz/limusina-new-york?hrid=9Ah0Tfp-3y1T5eUnEOWS6w&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” atmosphere includes amber-hued Art Deco details, dramatic lighting, and the decor of a modern supper club. “The space was a former parking garage, which we’ve revamped into a glamorous, elevated Mexican concept,” says Creative Director Lindsay Brandes. “We wanted it to feel like you were being transported into a new experience.”


Executive Chef Craig Koketsu’s menu includes a show-stopping Queso Fundido, flambeed with Xtabentún liqueur from the Yucatán, and the Black Truffle and Guava Jam Machete, a “[sweet and savory](https://www.yelp.com/biz/limusina-new-york?hrid=1SGnBNyrjhjRRg-uL2H_3g&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” sword-shaped quesadilla. The fan favorite: Long-Bone Short Rib Quesabirria featuring “[incredibly tender meat and rich consomé](https://www.yelp.com/biz/limusina-new-york?hrid=4eOMwmT8OSNlbQs08bfULA&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) .” For seafood lovers, Yelpers recommend the Red Snapper Tacos with super-crunchy rice-flake coating served on tortillas from Brooklyn’s[Sobre Masa](https://www.yelp.com/biz/sobre-masa-brooklyn-2) . Pair your meal with an inventive tequila or mezcal cocktail, and finish with the “[ridiculous good](https://www.yelp.com/biz/limusina-new-york?hrid=vR7CpomSrLKxAWwCp3SCaw&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” Dark Chocolate Masa Torta.


Insider tip:


[Make a reservation at Limusina via Yelp](https://www.opentable.com/r/limusina-new-york?utm_source=yelp&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=Yelp%20CPC) .


Yelpers say:


“The ambiance is warm and lively without being overwhelming. Limusina’s menu is all about Mexican classics with a creative twist, from upscale ceviches and aguachiles to playful small plates like truffle machete quesadillas, pork belly chicharrón, and over-the-top elote brûlée. Every item we ordered was better than the last, and you can really taste how much attention they put into balancing bold flavors and textures.” —Yelp Elite[Taylor B.](https://www.yelp.com/biz/limusina-new-york?hrid=EujoGWRRJUXXP4GQGvbQnQ&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) (9 cocktail bar reviews)


## 4.[Eylan](http://www.yelp.com/biz/eylan-menlo-park) , Menlo Park, California


From left: Interior; photo via


[Eylan](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/eylan-menlo-park?start=30&select=2w8WdFxQAgNib6sBOeVUsA) on Yelp. Pani puri; photo via


[Akiko I.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/eylan-menlo-park?start=60&select=A2fvjeL5DpTvErJiq8kBbA) on Yelp.


Cal-Indian cuisine takes center stage at this Menlo Park stunner from 2026 James Beard Award finalists


Chef Srijith Gopinathan and restaurateur Ayesha Thapar, the team behind[Ettan](https://www.yelp.com/biz/ettan-palo-alto) ,[Copra](https://www.yelp.com/biz/copra-san-francisco-2) , and[Little Blue Door](https://www.yelp.com/biz/little-blue-door-los-altos) . Built around a live-fire grill and seasonal Northern California ingredients, this Michelin Bib Gourmand selection reimagines Indian flavors with smoke, char, and surprising textures. Patterned tiles, warm lighting, plants, and artful decor create a “[sexy vibe](https://www.yelp.com/biz/eylan-menlo-park?hrid=CyM3eEe4TuslWuQqvEu-zQ&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” that feels celebratory without being too loud.


Prix-fixe choices include seasonal sigdi


(grilled) dishes or a family-style menu meant for sharing, with plenty of vegetarian and vegan options alongside seafood and wood-fired meats. Yelpers rave about the “[beautiful but also delicious](https://www.yelp.com/biz/eylan-menlo-park?hrid=FjuoxkZaDRyf776D5oZe7A&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” Taro Root Chaat, with crispy chips, sauces, sev, and pomegranate. Other standouts include “[light and refreshing](https://www.yelp.com/biz/eylan-menlo-park?hrid=ftVpqP1FFg-1KaB8WlCXBw&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” pani puri–style Chilled Green Grape Chaas; smoky Hispi Cabbage; juicy Eylan Crispy Chicken with house chili crisp aioli; and Roasted Cornish Hen with a tomatillo makhani sauce. Don’t skip dessert: Items like tender coconut pudding are “[the perfect way to end a meal](https://www.yelp.com/biz/eylan-menlo-park?hrid=2sSbiY5IangiljkzWE82wA&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) .”


Yelpers say:


“The Sigri Kabab and Taro Root Chaat were phenomenal appetizers — bursting with flavor and beautifully executed. For the main course, we ordered the Roasted Cornish Hen with paneer kulcha, Hispi cabbage with rumali roti, and the yakhni pulao. Every dish was delicious, thoughtfully plated, and deeply satisfying.” —[Vandy B.](https://www.yelp.com/biz/eylan-menlo-park?hrid=v7-Os1MGphN9SqEfzheS8w&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) (18 Indian food reviews)


## 5.[Lilo](http://www.yelp.com/biz/lilo-carlsbad) , Carlsbad, California


From left: Rock crab; photo via


[Johnny N.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/lilo-carlsbad?select=UkrgXIjmzvTlJmx_KPRaXA) on Yelp. Main cooking station (view from counter seat); photo via


[Layla F.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/lilo-carlsbad?select=P5gAXmjgW1SjFGzuUSAbuw) on Yelp.


This tasting-menu destination earned a Michelin star within two months of opening


— and Yelpers say it’s getting even better. Chef Eric Bost’s seafood-forward, multi-course experience draws on Californian seasonality and Japanese influences, showcasing ingredients sourced from both local farms and global producers. The latest from the team behind nearby[Jeune et Jolie](https://www.yelp.com/biz/jeune-et-jolie-carlsbad) , Lilo delivers what one diner calls “[a highly choreographed experimentation with flavors](https://www.yelp.com/biz/lilo-carlsbad?hrid=q_5NgoXcqy_s00SWG2N9Ew&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) .” Your evening unfolds in three acts: First, small bites and a refreshing welcome drink in a “[beautiful, garden-like](https://www.yelp.com/biz/lilo-carlsbad?hrid=7gxGVapbbjm9pstoF_9Mjw&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” courtyard anchored by a tree that was airlifted into place. Next, you’ll be served about a dozen meticulously assembled courses at a 24-seat chef’s counter. Last, have tea by the fire pit, where you’re presented with a printed menu signed by the team.


Standout dishes include the “[perfectly paired](https://www.yelp.com/biz/lilo-carlsbad?hrid=uO1_VHh3MC9cGcWaHbFzhA&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” sweet-and-salty N25 Kaluga Caviar atop ice cream flavored with orgeat (a floral almond syrup); Santa Barbara Sea Urchin with English pea and rose geranium; and A5 Miyazaki Wagyu with optional fresh black truffle shaving. The labor-intensive laminated brioche also earns raves. The full experience feels “[approachable and un-stuffy](https://www.yelp.com/biz/lilo-carlsbad?hrid=A-Pfqi8wWaQNTXlZg84rWA&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ” — servers remember your water preference and whether you’re left- or right-handed, while the dress code leans relaxed California-coastal.


Yelpers say:


“Each dish was a whimsical work of art and tasted so fresh and delicious. It’s amazing how the chefs are able to pair flavors that work so well together. The attention to detail was exquisite. Definitely make this a destination meal if you want a magical experience.” —Yelp Elite[Connie Y.](https://www.yelp.com/biz/lilo-carlsbad?hrid=9IeXKGDMJdBsT8jn4g4ICQ&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) (62 seafood reviews)


## 6.[1587 Prime](http://www.yelp.com/biz/1587-prime-kansas-city-2) , Kansas City, Missouri


From left: Interior; photo via


[Marina W.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/1587-prime-kansas-city-2?start=30&select=nQHeM4AgZ4muOZ88VEovxA) on Yelp. Co-founders Mikey Tanha and Tosh Berman; photo courtesy of 1587 Prime. Caviar-Topped Steak Bites; photo via


[1587 Prime](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/1587-prime-kansas-city-2?select=gk_2k47CKTaYaxbOH2_F2A) on Yelp.


Reservations book out months in advance at this upscale, contemporary steakhouse


, named for the jersey numbers of Kansas City NFL players Patrick Mahomes (15) and Travis Kelce (87), who partnered with hospitality group Noble 33 ([Toca Madera](https://www.yelp.com/biz/toca-madera-las-vegas-las-vegas) and[Meduza Mediterranea](https://www.yelp.com/biz/meduza-mediterrania-new-york-new-york-2) ) to open this popular new date-night spot.


Every detail is meticulously crafted — from locally sourced prime beef and rare global cuts (like Japanese Kagoshima A5 Wagyu) to the live music and staff in custom tuxedos. “There’s an energy to the room that’s hard to explain until you experience it,” says Noble 33 co-founder Tosh Berman. Steaks include a 16-ounce bone-in strip from Kansas’ Foote Ranch and a 40-ounce Wagyu Tomahawk from Idaho’s Snake River Farms, along with toppings, sauces, and compound butters. Yelp Elite Kaile T. calls the 8-ounce filet “[the best steak \[she’s\] ever tasted, cooked perfectly with bone marrow butter](https://www.yelp.com/biz/1587-prime-kansas-city-2?hrid=d9jDEL8dfPQo3OSN8Zgv2Q&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) .”


Beyond steaks, standout dishes include the Black Truffle Grilled Cheese (“It takes something nostalgic and familiar and turns it into a more elevated, luxurious experience,” says co-founder Mikey Tanha), Jumbo Lump Crab Cakes “[loaded with real crab](https://www.yelp.com/biz/1587-prime-kansas-city-2?hrid=7MLYDiPDFj04Vasvfkb8Kg&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) ,” and Truffle Fettuccini, which Yelper[Charren S.](https://www.yelp.com/biz/1587-prime-kansas-city-2?hrid=g-hrxSLCm4tJpG7zQBbm3g&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)) chose because Kelce recommended it on his weekly New Heights


podcast. “He has great taste!” she concludes.


Insider tip:


[Make a reservation at 1587 Prime via Yelp.](https://www.sevenrooms.com/explore/1587prime/reservations/create/search?tracking=yelp)


Yelpers say:


“As huge Chiefs fans, we were excited to experience it — and every detail, from the seating and service to the incredible ambiance, was top-notch. The petite 6-ounce filets, both with and without the shrimp topping, were cooked to perfection and full of flavor. The wine list was exceptional. The jazzy, bluesy music created the perfect atmosphere.” —Yelp Elite[JoAnn R.](https://www.yelp.com/biz/1587-prime-kansas-city-2?hrid=Rk1J7-IEqxghDn9yOXhSkQ&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct))


## 7.[Bar Boheme](http://www.yelp.com/biz/bar-boheme-las-vegas-2) , Las Vegas, Nevada


From left: Steak Tartare Banh Mi; photo credit: Jose Salinas, courtesy of Bar Boheme. Chef-Partner James Trees; photo courtesy of Bar Boheme. Interior; photo via


[Alia G.](https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/bar-boheme-las-vegas-2?start=90&select=b-nanL9sTFxFC4adjDbsAw) on Yelp.


Nestled in the vibrant Arts District of Las Vegas — recently named one of Yelp’s


[Top 20 Foodie Cities](https://www.yelp.com/article/yelp-and-lyft-name-the-top-foodie-cities-of-2026) —


this new French brasserie is earning raves.
